chunks: "The water of Zamzam is a cure for whatever it is drunk for."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام, the speaker of the hadith
key_terms.زَمْزَمَ: Zamzam, the sacred well-water associated with the sanctuary in Makkah
key_terms.لَهُ: for it, meaning for the purpose or intention connected to drinking it
key_terms.مَاءُ: water, specifically the blessed water being described

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about the healing virtue of Zamzam water?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that Zamzam water carries healing according to the intention for which it is drunk. The hadith highlights the special virtue of Zamzam and its blessed benefit in the context of hajj.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2164 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"The water of Zamzam is a cure for whatever it is drunk for."
